tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (10.5:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: library-brown
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.logo`, `.btn-primary`, `.user-avatar`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: antique-gold
tokens.usage: For premium feel. Used as text on `.brand-text h1`, `.btn-secondary`, `.stat-icon`. 7.4:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: For readability. Used as text on `body`, `.card-title`, `.user-name`. 15.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.brand-text p`, `.stat-label`, `.card-description`. 10.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: accent-primary
tokens.usage: For premium feel. Used as background on `body::before`, `header::before`, `.btn-secondary`; shadow/glow on `.brand-text h1`.

tokens.name: accent-secondary
tokens.usage: Used as background on `header::before`, `.badge-warning`; border on `.logo`, `.btn-primary`, `.badge-warning`.

tokens.name: border-color
tokens.usage: For premium feel. Used as background on `body::before`, `header::before`, `.btn-secondary`; shadow/glow on `.brand-text h1`.

tokens.name: border-gold
tokens.usage: For premium feel. Used as background on `body::before`, `header::before`, `.btn-secondary`; shadow/glow on `.brand-text h1`.

tokens.name: badge-success-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.stat-change.positive`, `.badge-success`; background on `.badge-success`; border on `.badge-success`. 8.5:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: category-tag-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: background on `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`; text on `.category-tag`. 17.8:1 on `page-bg`.
